source.sqlReaderQuery:
SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'';
DECLARE @workspaceName NVARCHAR(256);
DECLARE @chosenColumn SYSNAME;

-- Helper: If sys.workspaces exists, choose a best-fit column for display name
IF OBJECT_ID('sys.workspaces') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    ;WITH cols AS (
        SELECT name,
               CASE 
                 WHEN name = 'display_name' THEN 1
                 WHEN name = 'friendly_name' THEN 2
                 WHEN name = 'workspace_name' THEN 3
                 WHEN name = 'name' THEN 4
                 ELSE 100
               END AS priority
        FROM sys.columns
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('sys.workspaces')
          AND name IN ('display_name','friendly_name','workspace_name','name')
    )
    SELECT TOP (1) @chosenColumn = name
    FROM cols
    ORDER BY priority;
END

-- If we found a candidate column, try to read it
IF @chosenColumn IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sqlWs NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'SELECT TOP(1) @ws = CAST(' + QUOTENAME(@chosenColumn) + ' AS NVARCHAR(256)) FROM sys.workspaces';
    BEGIN TRY
        EXEC sp_executesql @sqlWs, N'@ws NVARCHAR(256) OUTPUT', @ws = @workspaceName OUTPUT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        -- any problem reading it -> fallback
        SET @workspaceName = NULL;
    END CATCH;
END

-- If no sys.workspaces or we couldn't read a friendly column, fallback to server name
IF @workspaceName IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@workspaceName)) = ''
BEGIN
    SET @workspaceName = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(256), SERVERPROPERTY('ServerName'));
END

-- SMART OVERRIDE:
-- if the value looks like a GUID (e.g. 290f6b06-3796-4928-9d58-f562fd0bfecd),
-- replace it with the desired friendly name.
IF TRY_CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @workspaceName) IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SET @workspaceName = N'Dynatech_MDM_Silver';
END

-- Alternatively, you can unconditionally set the name:
-- SET @workspaceName = N'Dynatech_MDM_Silver';

-- Escape single quotes so we can safely embed the workspace name into the dynamic query text
SET @workspaceName = REPLACE(ISNULL(@workspaceName, ''), '''', '''''' );

-- 2) Build the union ALL query across user databases
SELECT @sql = @sql + 
    'SELECT ''' + @workspaceName + ''' AS WorkspaceName,
            ' + QUOTENAME(name,'''') + ' AS DatabaseName,
            t.TABLE_SCHEMA AS SchemaName,
            t.TABLE_NAME AS TableName
     FROM ' + QUOTENAME(name) + '.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t
     WHERE t.TABLE_TYPE = ''BASE TABLE''
     UNION ALL
    '
FROM sys.databases
WHERE state = 0                                      -- online databases
  AND database_id > 4                                -- exclude system DBs (master,tempdb,model,msdb by id)
  -- optionally add more filters here

-- Remove trailing UNION ALL
IF LEN(@sql) = 0
BEGIN
    PRINT 'No databases to query.';
    RETURN;
END

SET @sql = LEFT(@sql, LEN(@sql) - LEN('
     UNION ALL
    '));

EXEC sp_executesql @sql;
GO
